prompts.Idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: new transparent pixel-art sprite animation atlas for a top-down Pokemon Mystery Dungeon-style survivor game. Create ANGEWOMON as her own full-body character, following the supplied reference: adult female angel warrior, long blonde hair, a dark silver visor helmet fully covering both eyes with a cross-shaped front and white wing-shaped temple ornaments, white fitted fantasy armor with gold breastplate, white gloves, white thigh-high armored boots, pink flowing ribbons, four pairs/eight white feathered wings attached to her back. Faithful character, normal tasteful action-game proportions, not pinup/anatomy emphasis. No Pokemon/Gardevoir/Ralts traits. Make a polished readable chibi overworld pixel sprite about 48 pixels tall with wing silhouette about 62 pixels wide, crisp pixel clusters and dark fine outlines. NEW sprite sheet, not a recolor. Layout EXACT 4 columns x 8 rows, 32 animation frames, equal grid cells, each frame centered on the same foot anchor. Idle animation: gentle breathing, hair/ribbon sway and subtle wing feathers flexing over four frames. Row order: facing down, down-left, left, up-left, up, up-right, right, down-right. All eight directions must actually turn the whole character; in side views the wings foreshorten and attach BEHIND the shoulders, not as two full frontal wings pasted beside the chest. Back row shows blonde hair and symmetrical wings attached to her back. Full body and all feathers/ribbons within each cell, no overlap between cells. Transparent background; no text, labels, cell borders, drop shadows, effects or scenery. White-gold-pink palette with a silver helmet; eyes always covered. No bow in idle. Native target cells 80x88, total atlas 320x704, can render enlarged but preserve grid exactly.
